But since the main issue is with Tomcat, perhaps the containers are handling the load, leading to increased disk usage.

Putting this together, the top candidates would be Tomcat02 because of the GC errors and high CPU usage. Then, the underlying disk issues (MG01 and MG02) might be contributing to the slowdown. Finally, Mysql01's high Handler Read Key and the disk busy percentages could be part of the problem, but the direct cause seems to be the Tomcat's resource constraints leading to higher disk I/O demands.
